How many hours can I work per week on Pre-Completion OPT?

Answer: On pre-completion OPT, you can work up to 20 hours per week while school is in session. If you're eligible to register for the next term and plan to do so, you may have approval to work full time when school is not in session.

Can I take a second job while on OPT?

Highlight key points and provide guidance for next steps.
Taking a second job while on OPT depends on whether it complies with your existing OPT employment authorization. Generally, you should ensure that your additional work aligns with your OPT authorization and doesn't exceed the allowed hours. To proceed safely:

1. **Check your OPT authorization**: Verify the conditions of your OPT authorization to confirm if taking a second job is allowed. Some OPT authorizations might restrict the number of jobs or the total hours you can work.
2. **Consult your DSO**: Discuss your plans with your Designated School Official (DSO) to get official advice tailored to your situation.
3. **Understand the hours**: Make sure that adding the hours from your second job won't cause you to exceed the maximum allowed weekly or monthly hours for OPT.
